name: Kariya Megumi
source:
A new nursing intern.  She is a pathetic girl who is suddenly blackmailed by a long-term hospitalized patient.

She also gets blackmailed by Sakaguchi, who uses her status as an intern to threaten her employment status.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=611]Getchu[/url]]
